label: First Council of Constantinople…: There is one God, the Father almighty, maker of heaven and…
locator: art. 1 (Πιστεύομεν εἰς ἕνα Θεὸν Πατέρα παντοκράτορα)
interpretation: The creed professes this clause as an article of faith. The claim records what the creed asserts, read from the Greek division of the pinned witness; it does not claim the article is true, which the skeleton derives only from open premises.
